release: CoreSpirit v80 — runtime decomposition + transactional realtime semantics

realtime_transaction.same_bucket_policy: restore the transaction baseline, increment revision, invalidate transaction-local caches and replace staged effects
realtime_transaction.commit_policy: promote the latest speculative state, commit the latest diagnostics/reuse boundary and flush only the matching transaction effects
realtime_transaction.rollback_policy: restore the transaction baseline including execution counters, discard matching events/reactive cache/diagnostics, and rehydrate the confirmed execution frame
realtime_transaction.historical_baseline_policy: confirmed historical bars update committed state so the next realtime transaction always begins from an explicit confirmed baseline

architecture_invariants: one language -> one compiler -> one stable IR -> one VM
CoreSpiritRuntime remains the external compatibility API
CoreSpiritRuntimeFacade coordinates services but does not execute instructions
realtime host side effects are transaction-scoped and identity-bound
stale transaction IDs cannot commit or rollback another transaction
speculative revisions cannot leak stale events or debugger traces into the committed runtime
confirmed historical execution establishes the committed realtime baseline
verification: focused TypeScript compile of runtime decomposition
